svg.text: DYNAMIC TEMPLATE • MOVING ARROWS & LIVE PACKETS
Where Does Your Agent Sit? Autonomy vs. Blast Radius — and the Open-Source + Google Moves to Safe Autonomy
Positions are rubric estimates from each design's controls; the arrows name the architectural moves (and tools) that relocate a design.
Safe but slow: humans approve everything
High autonomy with unbounded side effects
Safe because it cannot do much
Does a lot; every write is gated and reversible
AUTONOMY (how much the agent does without a human) ->
BLAST RADIUS / RISK (what a wrong action can damage) ->
Cannot act, so cannot harm — but also cannot finish work.
Writes to customers with no approval, no idempotency, no taint
No recursion_limit / RunConfig ceiling; one flaky tool becomes a $400
Acts freely inside a gVisor / E2B container; nothing ships until tests
Exactly-once writes with checkpoints; humans sign only mutations (IAP
Risk stays high because approvals become rubber stamps; throughput
Write tools unmounted by policy while reading untrusted content.
Moving right-and-down never requires a smarter model — it requires
deterministic controls (open source or managed) around the model.
